decisions.reason: After another year on the market, the maintenance oil is even more tied to the installed base and the firm's visible care-system offer, so management is likely to justify and continue it unless results clearly deteriorate.

This care line remains central to the firm's aftercare strategy for oiled floors, and continued commitment makes it easy for management to view any weaker performance as temporary rather than grounds for withdrawal.

The moisture-protection underlay still fits the firm's system-selling logic and benefits from prior launch commitment, though as an accessory it remains somewhat easier to prune than core flooring products.

The high-density underlay foam complements the floor range and has now gained another year of commitment, but its relatively substitutable accessory role keeps withdrawal risk higher than for more central lines.

The oak parquet line is closest to the firm's core business, likely embodies substantial investment across several models, and is therefore the product management is most inclined to defend and retain.
